title: DOJ sues Lyft for alleged discrimination against passengers with wheelchairs, guide dogs
summary: “Lyft denies service to hundreds, and likely thousands,” of people with disabilities, the government’s lawsuit alleges.

title: Tech upgrades boost ROI for local governments: report
summary: While most governments have a technology modernization road map, concerns about talent retention and budget cuts are widespread, an Ernst & Young survey found.

title: As data center backlash grows, a model law aims to give cities more control
summary: Data centers “are moving faster and at a larger scale than most local codes were built to handle,” Climate Mayors’ executive director said. Its model local law offers a framework for siting, permitting, transparency and community benefits.

title: New public transit, safer streets advocacy group aims to bring ‘national political firepower’
summary: The Center for American Mobility and a sister research and education fund aim to support transportation issues and empower local advocates, its CEO said.

title: Voters’ tax and spending decisions may narrow cities’ fiscal options
summary: Midterm ballot measure results could affect local government autonomy, according to an S&P report. They also reveal “a central theme on affordability and accountability,” an analyst said.

title: Commercial air taxi flights planned for these 5 US regions
summary: Archer Aviation, Beta Technologies and Joby Aviation are preparing for passenger operations with test flights in New York City, Los Angeles, the San Francisco Bay Area, Florida and Texas.

title: FEMA said these Savannah neighborhoods were not flooding. Residents knew otherwise.
summary: When Federal Emergency Management Agency models failed to capture chronic neighborhood flooding, Savannah sought data from affected communities to solve longstanding drainage problems.

title: ‘Watch what we do’: Philadelphia expands public performance dashboards
summary: Everything from where unsafe properties were reported to when a street was swept are now part of the city’s public performance dashboard.

title: Northern Illinois Transit Authority proposes first budget, capital spending plan
summary: With new state funding, the Chicago-area agency will focus on “frequent and reliable service, strong infrastructure and a system where people feel safe,” its acting president said.

title: Homeless population declined 6.3% in January point-in-time count, HUD says
summary: The historic decline is the second consecutive annual drop in homelessness following a record surge.
